name: KC Town Hall Tired of Tires source-return acceptance
purpose: Keep the resident-service case study source-backed, collectively credited, visually grounded, and free of resident data while exact public-safe handbill derivatives remain attached to their governance record.

hardGates.description: Every claim support string closes against a governed source and every intake, observation, claim, inquiry, and relation is canonical.
The public result remains project-maintained, dated May 2019 through September 2022, formula-estimated, and never City-audited or converted into unique residents.
Jamie's helped-design-and-operate and launch-driving roles stay visible without sole credit or responsibility for every pickup.
No resident name, address, phone, email, request note, protected locator, or raw row reaches the public surface.
Both exact 4x6 derivatives exist, are cleared only for public-safe display, exclude obsolete contacts, and are labeled as historical artifacts rather than current service notices.
The case study makes the resident promise, intake, field delivery, municipal handoff, measurement, and feedback loop legible to a hiring reader.

acceptance: All hard gates pass. A weighted average cannot override a failed privacy, truth, collective-credit, source-closure, artifact, or service-blueprint gate.
